  uninstall           Completely uninstalls ProtectEye from your system

short_tips: 20-20-20 Rule: Look at an object at least 20 feet (6 meters) away for 20 seconds.
Blink your eyes slowly and repeatedly to refresh and moisturize them.
Roll your shoulders back, sit up tall, and take a deep, slow breath.
Palming Technique: Warm your hands by rubbing them together, then gently cup over closed eyes.
Slowly roll your eyes in a circle clockwise, then gently counter-clockwise.
Inhale deeply through your nose, hold briefly, and exhale slowly through your mouth.
Gently stretch your wrists, palms, and fingers to relieve keyboard strain.
Shift your focus to the furthest corner of the room to relax your eye ciliary muscles.
Gently turn your head left to right to release subtle tension in your neck.
Close your eyes completely for a few moments and let your visual cortex reset.
Massage your temples with gentle circular fingertip motions to relieve pressure.
Tilt your chin down toward your chest slowly and feel the stretch along your cervical spine.
Focus alternating between your thumb held near your nose and a distant object.
Raise and release your eyebrows to relax the facial muscles around your forehead.
Take a sip of fresh water to keep your body and eye tissues hydrated.
Let your gaze soften into the distance and release all conscious visual focusing.
long_tips: Stand up! Walk around for a full minute to boost circulation throughout your body.
Drink a full glass of fresh water to hydrate your cells and sharpen your focus.
Neck Stretch: Gently tilt your head side to side, forward, and backward.
Look out the window and let your vision relax on the furthest horizon point.
Reach your arms high overhead and stretch your entire spine and torso.
Roll your shoulders backward in wide circles to relieve upper back and trap tension.
Open a window or step outside to breathe in fresh air and oxygenate your brain.
Clasp your hands behind your back, gently squeeze your shoulder blades and expand your chest.
Take a brief tea or coffee break and step completely away from digital screens.
Do light march-in-place leg lifts to stimulate lymphatic drainage and blood flow.
Splash cool water on your face to instantly refresh your senses and reduce eyelid fatigue.
Rotate your ankles in circles and stretch your calves to relieve sitting stiffness.
Practice 5 deep diaphragmatic breaths while keeping your spine straight and eyes closed.
Step away from your workstation entirely and allow your mental bandwidth to recharge.

short_exercises.title: Figure-8 Smooth Tracking
short_exercises.instruction: Keep your head steady. Follow the glowing blue light smoothly using only your eyes.

short_exercises.title: Near-Far Focus Shift
short_exercises.instruction: Hold your thumb 15 cm (6 in) from your nose. Alternate focusing 3s on your thumb, then 3s on a distant object to flex ciliary muscles.

short_exercises.title: Look Away from Screen
short_exercises.instruction: Look at an object at least 20 feet (6 meters) away. Completely release your eye focusing muscles.

short_exercises.title: Deep Squeeze Blinking
short_exercises.instruction: Stimulate Meibomian glands: Close eyes for 2s, gently squeeze for 2s, then open and relax to restore the tear lipid film.

short_exercises.title: Smooth Circular Orbit
short_exercises.instruction: Without straining, smoothly trace the moving dot around the circle in a continuous rhythm.

short_exercises.title: Peripheral Vision Expansion
short_exercises.instruction: Gaze gently at the center without moving your eyes, consciously noticing the room's far left and right edges. Break tunnel-vision.

short_exercises.title: Warm Palms & Diaphragmatic Breath
short_exercises.instruction: Warm your palms by rubbing them, gently cup over your eyes. Inhale and exhale with the pulsing ring.

short_exercises.title: Vertical Saccadic Tracking
short_exercises.instruction: Keep your head completely still. Smoothly follow the vertical oscillation of the glowing dot up and down.

short_exercises.title: Horizontal Eye Sweep
short_exercises.instruction: Without moving your head, smoothly track the dot moving side to side to flex ocular muscles.

short_exercises.title: Hydration & Eye Reset
short_exercises.instruction: Blink slowly and fully several times to replenish the tear film and rest from monitor glare.

long_exercises.title: Stand Up & Walk Around
long_exercises.instruction: Step completely away from your desk! Walk around for 1-2 minutes to stimulate blood circulation and stretch your legs.

long_exercises.title: Chin Tuck & Neck Alignment
long_exercises.instruction: Gently push your chin straight back with two fingers. Align your ears directly over your shoulders to decompress suboccipital nerves.

long_exercises.title: Cervical Tension Release
long_exercises.instruction: Roll your shoulders backward. Gently tilt your head side to side and forward to release neck and spine stiffness.

long_exercises.title: Torso & Spinal Twist
long_exercises.instruction: Sit or stand tall. Gently twist your torso to the right, then to the left, taking 3 deep breaths to mobilize thoracic vertebrae.

long_exercises.title: Tall Glass of Water & Fresh Air
long_exercises.instruction: Drink a full glass of water. Open a window or step outside to replenish your body and brain with fresh oxygen.

long_exercises.title: Psoas & Hip Flexor Stretch
long_exercises.instruction: Stand up and take a step forward into a gentle lunge. Stretch the front hip flexors (psoas) that shorten during prolonged sitting.

long_exercises.title: Spine Alignment & Chest Stretch
long_exercises.instruction: Clasp your hands behind your back, squeeze your shoulder blades gently together, and take deep restorative breaths.

long_exercises.title: Wrist and Finger Stretches
long_exercises.instruction: Rotate your wrists and gently stretch your fingers back to relieve strain from keyboard and mouse work.
